lines.japanese:
淡い朝の光で目が覚めた。
　昨日の貧血の後遺症か、体はまだ少し重かったが気分は晴れやかだった。
　……何日ぶりだろう。
　こんな、なにも不安なことのない朝を迎えられたのは。
　くわえて今日は創立記念日で学校が休みときている。
　いつものようにあわただしく学校の準備をする必要もなく、ゆったりと朝を満喫できる。

lines.maoEnglish:
Pale morning light wakes me.
Perhaps it is an aftereffect of yesterday’s anemia; my body still feels a little heavy, but my spirits are clear.
How many days has it been?
A morning with nothing to fear.
Better yet, school is closed for Founding Day.
There is no need to rush through my usual preparations, and I can savor the morning at my leisure.

“Akiha; hey, Akiha.”

She is sleeping soundly, so there is no reason to force her awake.

……八年前。
　ふたりで遊んでいる時、きまって後ろをついてきた黒髪の少女。
　無口な子だったけれど、秋葉はずっと自分たちについてきた。
　滅多に笑うことがなくて、時々見せる笑顔はどこか哀しそうで、儚かった。
―――何も知らなかった子供の頃。
　俺は本当に、秋葉に嬉しそうに笑ってほしくて、何度も何度も屋敷から庭に連れ出していたんだっけ。

lines.maoEnglish:
Eight years ago.
Whenever the two of us went out to play, a black-haired girl would invariably trail behind us.
She was a quiet child, but Akiha followed us everywhere.
She almost never smiled, and her rare smiles always seemed sad and fragile.
―――Back when we were children who knew nothing.
I had wanted so badly to see Akiha smile with real happiness that I kept coaxing her out of the house and into the garden, over and over again.

“Good morning, Brother. Did you sleep well?”
She greets me, entirely ignoring that she fell asleep here—typical Akiha.
Her nerve, or perhaps her talent for brazening things out, is beyond ordinary human limits.
“Morning. Thanks to you, I slept very well. I have not woken to such a beautiful morning in ages.”
“I see. Then you’re feeling better as well?”
“I’m still a little sluggish. We have the day off anyway, so I’ll take it easy.”

…… I won't sleep.

Down they come, one after another.
Perhaps it is the way her black hair sways like the leaves.
Because of that, and her fragile body, Akiha looks like a mirage.

　秋葉はまた淡く微笑んだ。

“Brother? What is wrong, your face is red. If you still feel ill, shall we move to the terrace?”
“No, I am fine. I want to keep looking a little longer, so I will stay here.”
“Yes, it truly is a lovely night. This is my favorite view on the entire estate.”
Akiha smiles faintly again.
The sight makes my heart leap.
Perhaps it is because she seems so calm—too gentle.
Amid the red fallen leaves.
Akiha Tohno looks many times lovelier than usual.
